name: Write detailed long-form articles on various topics
description: Users requested the creation of long-form articles on diverse subjects, often specifying word count, language, structural elements, or stylistic goals like SEO optimization, viral appeal, or specific formatting conventions. These requests covered a wide range of topics, from medical and technical guides to political, philosophical, and creative pieces, typically requiring comprehensive, detailed explanations rather than short essays or vague prompts.
